summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K attaching an announcement by its subsidiary, The Generation Essentials Group (TGE). TGE's board approved a $10 million share repurchase program, funded from existing cash, allowing open-market, privately negotiated, or block-trade purchases subject to Rule 10b-18/10b5-1 requirements. Concurrently, controlling shareholder AMTD Digital Inc., directors, and management voluntarily agreed to a two-year lock-up on their TGE shares. The board believes TGE shares trade at a significant discount to asset values (total assets ~$1.7B post-acquisitions, net assets ~$971M). This capital-return move signals confidence and aims to enhance shareholder value. Watch for periodic board reviews of program size and price; no premium or fixed price per share specified.
